'''{{PAGENAME}}''' and  '''Caroline''' are NPC female researchers found nearby the {{Rubi|Solis Lens Array|Lahai-Roi Resonance Nexus}} during the day.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:Did Black Shores change their recruiter?

==Dialogue==
:Caroline: [[Basic Introduction to the Black Shores I|KU-Tata]] from the Black Shores HR... applying for a campus visitation pass?
:Caroline: Did the Black Shores change their recruiters? I thought it was Ms. [[Paranora]] and Mr. [[Aalto]].
:Ristina: Yeah. Mr. Aalto got sent to the New Federation for urgent marine insurance issues, so the application changed at the last minute.
:Caroline: But biometric scans and frequency checks don't work on a [[KU-Roro]]... How am I supposed to approve this?
:Ristina: Good point... Has a KU-Roro ever entered Lahai-Roi before? How did they handle it?
:Caroline: Let me check... Oh, the Black Shores just shipped it here... Shipped it?
:Caroline: Sender: Mr. Aalto. Courier: Mr. Wei from Lollo Logistics.
:Ristina: E-economy shipping? Well, I guess that works...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Triva==
* Aalto's boat issue happened during {{Quest|Through the Sea Thou Break}}
* There is a Lollo Logistic member in Black Shores named [[Weyl]], who specifically handles Black Shores deliveries.
